dialogue.speaker: Arlan
dialogue.text: Malika! Can you help me? I have a big problem.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: Of course! What's wrong? Can I see?

dialogue.speaker: Arlan
dialogue.text: I need to design the slides for my CS presentation. But I can't draw at all!

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: Ha! I can help with that — I can draw and design very well. Can you explain the topic to me?

dialogue.speaker: Arlan
dialogue.text: Yes, I can explain it. The topic is Artificial Intelligence. It's about how computers can learn.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: Interesting! I can make beautiful illustrations for it. I can also use Canva — can you?

dialogue.speaker: Arlan
dialogue.text: No, I can't use Canva. I only know coding tools. Can you show me how?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: Sure! And can you help me too? I can't understand my Economics maths homework.

dialogue.speaker: Arlan
dialogue.text: Yes, I can! I'm good at maths. I can explain it step by step. Can you come to the library at 5?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: Yes, I can! Perfect. Oh — can you also translate this English article for me?

dialogue.speaker: Arlan
dialogue.text: I can read it with you, but I can't translate it perfectly. My English is okay but not perfect.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: That's fine! We can read it together. You help me with maths, I help you with design!

dialogue.speaker: Arlan
dialogue.text: Deal! Can we start right now? My presentation is tomorrow morning!

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: Tomorrow morning?! Why didn't you say so? Come — I can work fast when I need to!

dialogue.speaker: Arlan
dialogue.text: Thank you, Malika. I really can't do this without you!

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: That's what friends are for! Together we can do anything!
